table.retrieve:
SELECT 	
	GroupName=CASE :as_grouptype WHEN 'M' THEN Manufacturer.name WHEN 'C' THEN itemcategory.name WHEN 'P' THEN itemPacking.name ELSE itemclass.name END,
	Item.Name,  
	aliasname=item.customicode, 
	active=CASE item.active WHEN 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,
	PurPrice = Case When (isnull(sum(cast(GodownDetail.CurrQty as int)),0) % Item.PackUnits ) = 0 THEN Item.PurPrice Else Round(Item.PurPrice/Item.PackUnits,2) End, 
	SalePrice = Case When (isnull(sum(CAST(GodownDetail.CurrQty AS INT)),0) % Item.PackUnits ) = 0 THEN Item.SalePrice Else Round(Item.SalePrice/Item.PackUnits,2) End, 
	Item.PackUnits,  
	serverdate=getdate() ,
	TotalQTY = isnull(sum(GodownDetail.CurrQty),0),
	PackQTY = CAST((isnull(sum(GodownDetail.CurrQty),0) / CASE WHEN Item.PackUnits > 0 THEN Item.PackUnits ELSE 1 END) AS INT),
	LooseQty =  isnull(sum(GodownDetail.CurrQty),0) - (CAST((isnull(sum(GodownDetail.CurrQty),0) / CASE WHEN Item.PackUnits > 0 THEN Item.PackUnits ELSE 1 END) AS INT) * Item.PackUnits)
FROM 	
	Manufacturer,   
	Item
	LEFT OUTER JOIN GodownDetail ON (Item.ICode = GodownDetail.ICode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN ItemClass ON (Item.iccode=itemclass.iccode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN ItemPacking ON (Item.packcode=itempacking.packcode),
	ItemCategory
WHERE 
	CASE :as_grouptype 
		WHEN 'M' THEN Item.ManfCode
		WHEN 'C' THEN Item.ICatCode 
		WHEN 'P' THEN item.PackCode 
		ELSE Item.ICCode END IN (:ai_groupcode) and
	Item.active=1 and
	Manufacturer.manfcode = Item.ManfCode and
	Item.icatcode=itemcategory.icatcode
GROUP BY 
	Manufacturer.name,
	itemcategory.name,
	Itemclass.name,
	itempacking.name,
	Item.name,
	item.customicode, 
	Item.Active, 
	Item.purprice, 
	Item.SalePrice, 
	Item.PackUnits
